answer: Clone fleets fail a split-custody gate I run at the south wharf. Each new identity must leave one half of a numbered walnut tag with the night clerk and carry the mate half; only when the evening tide peaks between 1.42 and 1.48 meters, two independent witnesses photograph both serials in the same 20-second frame. A tag that already appears in the prior 72-hour log, or a tide reading outside that band, forfeits the 27.4 POA bond and bars that controller for eight arrivals.
